grammar.summary: 本课学习表牺牲的 at the expense of 与 worth doing。

points.title: at the expense of 表以……为代价
points.explanation: Progress is achieved at the expense of nature. 牺牲 A 成就 B 的利弊表达。

examples.en: Modern cities are built at the expense of the countryside.
examples.cn: 现代城市是以牺牲乡村为代价建立的。

points.title: worth + doing 表值得
points.explanation: Is it worth sacrificing so much? worth 后直接接动名词（主动形式被动含义）。

examples.en: These benefits are not worth the cost.
examples.cn: 这些好处不值这个代价。
